name: 安东尼·范·列文虎克
bio_short: 荷兰科学家和透镜制造师，被誉为“微生物学之父”。他改进了显微镜，并成为历史上第一个观察和描述单细胞生物（如细菌）的人（`leeuwenhoek_bacteria_1676`）。
bio_short_en: A Dutch scientist and lens grinder, known as the 'Father of Microbiology'. He improved the microscope and was the first person in history to observe and describe single-celled organisms, such as bacteria (`leeuwenhoek_bacteria_1676`).
